payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple instances of how the generalization ability of the NCEL model is verified through evaluations on various datasets and comparisons with baseline models.

claims.text: The generalization ability of NCEL is verified by evaluating it on five different benchmarks after training on Wikipedia hyperlinks to avoid overfitting.
NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines, demonstrating favorable generalization ability across multiple datasets.
The model shows good generalization ability to difficult entity linking tasks, particularly in noisy datasets.
